title: Strike Force - War on Terror
description:
As an elite operator of Strike Force, your mission is simple: stop global terrorism by any means necessary. Fight through 15 action-packed missions across scorching deserts and frozen arctic landscapes, eliminate hostile forces, rescue critical locations, and complete objectives using your own tactics.

Whether you prefer long-range precision, aggressive assaults, or careful room clearing, every mission gives you the freedom to approach the battlefield your way.

Take the fight online with classic multiplayer modes, dedicated servers, full bot support, and a wide selection of modern weapons.

Features• 15 single-player missions across two campaigns

• Fight in desert and arctic environments

• Modern arsenal including pistols, SMGs, assault rifles, sniper rifles, machine guns and shotguns

• Plan your own approach to every mission

• Dedicated server and player-hosted multiplayer

• Supports up to 16 players

• Full bot support for multiplayer

• 4 unique multiplayer classes

• Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch

• 5 multiplayer maps

• Ongoing free updates

Update 2.0The biggest update in the game's history introduces:

• Unreal Engine 5.7 upgrade

• Improved graphics, lighting, weather and rendering

• Enhanced weapon animations and sound effects

• New soundtrack

• Improved networking and multiplayer stability

• Dedicated server improvements and launcher

• Mission loadout selection

• Full voice-over from the Nintendo Switch edition

• Reworked missions with numerous gameplay improvements

• Countless bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements

Join the fight. Stop the terrorists. Complete the mission.
description_short: As a member of Strike Force, it is your job to defeat a hostile terrorist group. In Strike Force Remastered, you will engage in 15 different missions with your own tactics, in every possible terrain. Develop your own plan to attack the terrorists!
